:::{#def-reducible-risk}
#### Reducible risk

In the squared-error risk decomposition of @thm-risk-decomposition,
the excess risk from choosing the prediction function $\predfn$ instead of the conditional mean,

$$\E{\sqf{\E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar} - \predfnf{\Predvar}}} \ge 0$$

is the **reducible risk**.

:::
